summary: The task manager assigns control and execution instances, sets jobs to waiting and notifies the dispatcher through pg_notify. TASK_MANAGER_TIMEOUT (default 300 s) plus TASK_MANAGER_TIMEOUT_GRACE_PERIOD bound each run, START_TASK_LIMIT (default 100) caps jobs started per run, and task_manager__schedule_seconds shows run duration.
questions: Why does the task manager time out with thousands of pending jobs?
How do I measure task manager run time?
How does controller schedule jobs onto instances?
